newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint down after overnight dlr/mark rise.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint down after overnight dlr/mark rise.

text.p: Hungary's forint eased against the dollar in quiet morning trade on Wednesday, in-line with the mark's losses against the dollar after Tuesday's market close in Hungary, dealers said.
The forint opened at 155.60/65 against the dollar, down from Tuesday's close of 155.20/25. At 0920 GMT, the forint stood at 155.65/70.
"The forint weakened as the dollar is stronger (against the mark)," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank.

Dealers said the forint also weakened slightly against the currency basket, which is made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu, dropping some four pips below the central bank's resistance level (bid).
This was probably caused by a bank client's order for dollar, Kalman said.
But he expected the forint to return to the National Bank of Hungary's bid as no factors were seen keeping it below the resistance level to which it is usually pinned.
